tools.name: check_token
tools.description: Look up the latest scam-screen verdict (PASS/FAIL/SKIP), 0-100 score and reasons for a Solana token mint, from our own database. Read-only, no live lookups: a mint we have not screened recently returns found=false, which does NOT mean the token is safe. NFA/DYOR.

tools.name: list_passing_tokens
tools.description: Solana tokens that currently pass the automated scam screen, best score first, with warnings. Passing lowers but does not remove rug risk. NFA/DYOR.

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description: Most recent automated alerts: passing tokens that flipped to fail, or whose price collapsed, newest first. Heuristic, not proof of wrongdoing. NFA/DYOR.

tools.name: check_wallet
tools.description: Is this Solana wallet (usually a token creator) on our heuristic bad-wallet list? Not being listed does NOT mean a wallet is safe. NFA/DYOR.
